meta.name: Anthracite
meta.description: An old case is wrenched open when a reporter goes missing, leading his web sleuth daughter to a small mountain town haunted by a sect, secrecy and death.

videos.title: Still on Fire
videos.overview: Convinced that her missing dad is in danger, Ida follows his trail to a town in the French Alps. A second disappearance brings an old case to light.

videos.title: The 13th Disciple
videos.overview: As Ida and Jaro look to old VHS tapes for clues, a suspicious Giovanna visits the Arcacia lab. Trouble brews ahead of the annual festival of Lévionna.

videos.title: Trust No One
videos.overview: Gio and Ida find common ground as they explore hidden mountain terrain. Jaro and Roméo seek out a recluse who may know the truth about Roxane Vial.

videos.title: Levia Borelis
videos.overview: Gio's theories create cracks in her marriage. Ida tries to make sense of DNA tests as Jaro and Roméo visit a psychiatric hospital in a state of chaos.

videos.title: A Darker Shadow
videos.overview: Jaro and Gio pair up after her son makes a disturbing discovery in the mines. Roméo is the guest of honor at a tense dinner with Hari and his mother.

videos.title: The Point of Equilibrium
videos.overview: As terror ensues inside the mine, a riot breaks out at the Arcacia lab. Gio desperately attempts to locate the group in the tunnel before it's too late.
